title: Replay judge no_default fires on the optimal-setpoint sensor at the configured max_temperature
claim: On the owner's replay window (hours 7-9) tests/replay.py:inv_no_default reports sensor ...optimal_setpoint=21.0 as a leaked ThermalState default although the value is the action's setpoint clamped at the configured max_temperature (21.0 in the replay entry), because SETPOINT_KEYS exempts only valve_target_recommendation; with the setpoint sensor's keys added to SETPOINT_KEYS the offender count goes 1 -> 0.
mechanism: inv_no_default flags any temperature equal to a ThermalState default that no input read, unless the sensor's translation key is in SETPOINT_KEYS and the configured value equals it. CurrentSetpointSensor (keys current_setpoint/optimal_setpoint) publishes current_action.setpoint, which is bounded by min/max_temperature; at the bound it equals a config value that happens to equal room_temperature's default, which the module's own comment names for the valve target and leaves open for this sensor.
instrumented_symbol: tests/replay.py:inv_no_default (SETPOINT_KEYS) over heatpump_optimizer.sensor:CurrentSetpointSensor.native_value in the seeded replay

perturbation.change: --perturb setpoint: SETPOINT_KEYS gains current_setpoint and optimal_setpoint -> (max_temperature, min_temperature), in memory

metric_definition: no_default offenders tests/replay.py:run_fixture returns over the seeded replay's hours 7-9 of the owner's window.
phenomenon_property: No replay judge reports a published setpoint that equals the configuration value bounding it as a leaked constructor default: every sensor publishing a config-bounded setpoint is in SETPOINT_KEYS with the options that bound it.
seam_rule: grep -n 'setpoint' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/sensor.py | grep '__init__\|super().__init__'   # every setpoint-publishing sensor's keys, against tests/replay.py SETPOINT_KEYS

null_control.note: hours 1-3 of the same window, where the setpoint is not at the bound

proposed_fix_scope: tests/replay.py SETPOINT_KEYS: add the setpoint sensor's key with (max_temperature, min_temperature) and a control in controls() for a setpoint at the configured bound; no production change.
